newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up on Iraq, but within London's range.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up on Iraq, but within London's range.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures for October were firmer on Thursday, supported by the latest round of tension in Iraq, but prices stayed just within London's day-earlier range.
October, which expires on Friday, traded as high as $23.80, up 22 cents from London's close of $23.58 but within London's trading range of $23.04 to $23.82.
October was last traded at $23.70, up 12 cents.
Market volume was a healthy 719 lots.
November last traded at $22.95 per barrel, up eight cents from London's close.
NYMEX October crude, which rose 63 cents in New York to $24.75, last traded at $24.87 but was bid at $24.70.
